name: Humbleness
overview: Scripture calls believers to walk humbly with God, embodying meekness and lowliness as exemplified by Christ, who invites us to take His yoke and find rest for our souls. True greatness in the kingdom of heaven is linked to humbling oneself like a child, and God promises to exalt those who humble themselves while humbling the proud. This humility is expressed through patience, forbearing love, and putting away anger and harmful speech, reflecting a heart transformed by grace and devotion to Christ.
